chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Rabi' al-Musally, from Ma'ruf ibn Kharbouz, from the one who saw the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) eating bread with grapes.
He was eating bread with grapes.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) eat with bread according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of the Rawandiyya scholars, illustrates the Prophetic Sunnah of combining bread and grapes, a practice often cited in Shia jurisprudence to validate this specific dietary combination. It underscores the Imams' adherence to simplicity and moderation, serving as a practical model for daily consumption that balances nutrition and taste without extravagance.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al hakam, from Al Rabie Al Musally, for Marouf Bin Kharbouz,
(It has been narrated) from the one who saw Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> eating the bread with the grapes’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al- Rabi ‘ al-Musliy from Ma‘ruf ibn Kharrabudh from those who had seen ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, eating bread with grapes.”
